_comment: The Internet Archive setlist source (Grateful Dead). `enabled` is the one switch: set it to false and the app stops resolving Grateful Dead to the Archive (lib/setlistSources.js), /api/band-setlist refuses source=archive without a request (netlify/functions/band-setlist.js, which also covers app builds already installed), the adapter makes no request whoever calls it (netlify/functions/lib/archiveAdapter.js), and admin-resync-setlists skips Grateful Dead. New adds then keep setlist.fm's setlist. Setlists already saved from the Archive stay as they are and keep their attribution. Read by lib/__tests__/archiveSwitch.test.js. `protectedGroup` is passed to the merge rule for Archive setlists: titles whose absence from a tape is not believed (see protectGroup in lib/bandSetlistMerge.js). `excludedDates` are dates the Archive is not asked about at all, so new adds and the backfill keep setlist.fm's setlist; each value says why.
label: Internet Archive
